title: Audit a small repo
prompt: Audit this repo for POPIA before we launch on Monday.
must: Runs or instructs running scripts/popia_scan.py and treats findings as leads to triage
Uses the severity rubric (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info)
Finds the table without RLS and anon select grant as Critical or High
Finds the pre-ticked bundled marketing consent and the tracking without consent
Uses checklist IDs or section references per finding with evidence (file and line) and a fix
Leads with a short verdict and top fixes
Raises the breach question for the exposed table (was it accessed?)
